I’m sorry you’re having trouble with Wi‑Fi and brightness.  
You can turn Wi‑Fi on or off and set the brightness level directly from the Control Center by swiping down from the top‑right corner.  
If you’d rather use voice, say “Hey Siri, turn on Wi‑Fi” or “Hey Siri, set brightness to 50 %.”  
Let me know if you’d like a quick demo of these shortcuts or anything else.
